info.title: Starport API design
info.description: Starport shared API contract. The local read-only application implements configuration projections and issuer-sourced asset metadata; other business operations remain design-only or disabled. Catalog metadata is not a price, executable quote, eligibility decision, chain verification, or Starlink routing evidence. Financial execution remains off.

get.summary: Browse issuer-sourced Stock Token metadata
get.description: Implemented as a local read-only catalog in the private application. Retrieves only the fixed official Robinhood assets endpoint, filters chain4663, validates metadata, and uses bounded caching. q searches symbol/name/address locally; it is never forwarded as an upstream URL. Pages are snapshot-bound and stale results are explicitly labeled. A changed pagination snapshot returns409 STALE_DATA. No synthetic fallback rows, quotes, prices, wallet data or tradeability are provided.

post.summary: Record a transaction hash already submitted by the user wallet
post.description: Shared by Earn and Pay. Never accepts signed transactions, arbitrary calldata or an instruction to broadcast. Record the hash against the existing preparation, then independently verify chain, sender, destination, call, amount and expiry. Ambiguity remains unknown_submission. For an invoice payment, also match the bound invoice ID/version and canonical invoice-settlement event; a transaction to the same recipient for the same amount alone is insufficient. Event identity cannot settle multiple invoices. Duplicate reports attach to the existing preparation; a mismatch never marks the invoice paid.

post.summary: Prepare a direct or invoice payment for the user wallet
post.description: Derive the actual payer from the wallet session and bind recipient, approved asset, chain, exact raw amount, invoice ID/version where present, accepted terms, fee bounds and enforced deadline into one immutable preparation and scoped idempotency record. Open invoices accept an eligible session payer; restricted invoices require their named payer. Atomically reserve the invoice/version against duplicate pending preparation; a conflicting payer receives INVOICE_PAYMENT_PENDING without disclosure. An approved invoice-aware payment adapter must enforce single settlement by invoice key. No server signing, payment or conversion occurs here. Require an issued request with the matching verified issuer signature/digest/version. The prepared bounded router call carries only the invoice authorization needed for settlement, not server authority. Recheck contract-wallet signature validity when applicable. Unsigned drafts fail INVOICE_NOT_ISSUED; mismatched or invalid issuer authorization fails INVOICE_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID.

post.summary: Verify the issuer wallet authorization and issue an immutable invoice
post.description: Owner wallet session only. Match the path invoice, review ID, immutable version, expected digest, domain, exact typed fields and unexpired signBefore. Recompute the EIP-712 digest from stored terms; verify the issuer/payee EOA signature or EIP-1271 contract-wallet signature with the reviewed chain/domain. A session signature is not valid here. In one idempotent transaction store the scoped authorization artifact/verification metadata, set issuedAt and state=open, and retire the draft review for signing. Never sign on the server, change terms under the signature, transfer funds, or enable a draft for public payment before verification. Preview/unconfigured deployments reject real signatures with CAPABILITY_DISABLED or UNCONFIGURED; only separately enabled environments may verify them.

Preparation.description: Creation only prepares a bounded action, never a delegation, withdrawal, claim or payment itself. Only ready, unexpired, all-checks-passed preparations can contain unsignedTransaction and require a wallet signature. Preview/unconfigured/paused modes return blocked with null transaction or an explicit error. Allowance changes require a new preparation after a separate user-approved wallet action. Client awaiting-signature/rejection is not chain state. Finalized follows independent reconciliation; API acceptance never settles funds. cancellationAllowed is true only for blocked preparations with no wallet request ever released; ready preparations cannot be cryptographically invalidated by an offchain cancel API. expiresAt may not exceed the enforced actionDeadline. A stale or expired UI request is not proof that a user-held signed transaction can no longer settle; late observations must still be reconciled. For payment preparations, owner is the actual authenticated payer; invoiceId/invoiceVersion bind the immutable invoice terms, or both are null for direct payment. Non-payment preparations use null for both. The stored canonical idempotency digest includes payer, recipient, chain, asset, amount, invoice/version, deadline and accepted terms. A reported hash must match this exact action and the approved invoice-aware settlement event before payment is recognized.

Invoice.description: Private issuer/payer accounting record. Creation starts as an immutable private draft; no public sharing/payment preparation until its issuer wallet authorization is verified and issuedAt is set. Public request terms use InvoiceView and never reveal payer history/payment IDs/signatures. paid requires one matched invoice-aware settlement with exact version, authenticated payer, chain, asset, recipient and amount, then finality. PaymentPrepareRequest.description: The payer is derived from the authenticated wallet session, never supplied by an anonymous link. For an invoice, invoiceId and invoiceVersion must identify the current unpaid request; recipient, chain, asset, exact amount, terms and deadline must match. An open invoice accepts any eligible authenticated payer; a restricted invoice requires the named authorizedPayer. Direct payments use invoiceId=null and invoiceVersion=null. Bind the canonical request and session payer to the scoped Idempotency-Key; duplicate/conflicting or already pending invoice settlement cannot create a second economic action. Missing payment-asset or invoice-aware adapter support blocks preparation. Invoice payments additionally require issuedAt and verified issuer authorization matching the exact immutable version/digest. Never infer issuer consent from an authentication session or permit an unsigned draft. Revalidate EIP-1271 issuer authorization at preparation/execution if it can change.

x-language-policy: English only until the complete core is finished; no i18n runtime in this phase.
x-idempotency-policy: Retain financial-intent and preparation identity for their full lifecycle. Same scoped key plus same canonical body returns the existing resource; changed body conflicts. Ordinary non-financial writes retain keys for at least 24 hours. Secret issuance returns plaintext once only. Database uniqueness and transactional outbox ownership are mandatory.
x-webhook-signing-policy: Planned v1: Starport-Signature includes key version, timestamp and HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + period + exact UTF-8 request-body bytes. Receivers verify constant-time, reject timestamps beyond the configured 300-second tolerance, deduplicate eventId and process resourceRevision without assuming ordered delivery. Key rotation, clock policy and test vectors require implementation review before activation.
x-breaking-design-changes: Generic read models replaced with strict concrete schemas.
Developer financial scopes removed until an explicit delegated-user-consent contract exists.
Private receipt detail requires owner or assigned-operator authorization.
Draft cancellation is constrained to avoid claiming offchain revocation of released signing payloads.
R4 invoice creation returns a private unsigned draft; separate verified issuer authorization is required for issuance.
R4 wallet-direct Trade returns an unsigned router walletRequest; the retained relay-authorization endpoint is disabled.
SPORT ticker and supplied treasury target are recorded without inventing deployment or ownership.
Initial earning epochs are 259200 seconds from an explicitly configured anchor, not weekly.
x-invoice-settlement-policy: Open invoices are public-safe requests, not bearer spending grants. Payment preparation binds the authenticated payer, exact invoice/version and terms under scoped idempotency and a unique active settlement reservation. The approved payment adapter must enforce one settlement per chain/contract/invoice/version key. Independently match sender, recipient, asset, exact amount and canonical invoice event; identify events by chainId/transactionHash/logIndex and track blockHash/finality. A reported or unrelated transfer never establishes payment. Do not release an uncertain reservation or prepare another payer until enforced expiry or invalidation plus canonical reconciliation establishes safety.
x-invoice-issuance-policy: POST /v1/invoices creates a private immutable draft. A configured exact issuer EIP-712 review is signed by the issuer wallet and verified by POST /v1/invoices/{id}/issuer-authorization, including EIP-1271 where applicable. Only issued requests can produce InvoiceView or payment preparations. No server signing or authentication-signature reuse.
x-trade-execution-mode: wallet_direct; legacy authorization operation retained but disabled; initial hashes are reported through shared read-only reconciliation.

x-reward-epoch-policy.budgetCap: min(explicit raw asset cap, 25% actual reconciled spendable surplus) per explicitly approved funded epoch; not APR
